verdict.rationale: Terraform's own `terraform test` runs against test-specific, short-lived resources, which the docs say prevents risk to existing infrastructure or state. Since v1.7 it can also mock provider data, so tests need not touch real infrastructure at all. `terraform plan` adds a documented dry-run preview of changes, and a community user confirms plans are what make iterating safely possible. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of `terraform test` and mock-provider isolation, and documentation of persistent isolated sandbox environments (e.g., separate state or workspaces) for ongoing agent testing.
